options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: force
options.description: Set the force flag to true to modify some of the AutoSupport configurations that are otherwise blocked when the automatic update feature is enabled. Without this flag set to true, an attempt to disable AutoSupport, modify the transport to SMTP, or disable the AutoSupport OnDemand feature fails if the automatic update feature is enabled.

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number. When C(use_rest) is set to auto, this may force a switch to ZAPI based on the version and platform capabilit

options.name: from_address
options.description: specify the e-mail address from which the node sends AutoSupport messages.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: hostname_in_subject
options.description: Specify whether the hostname of the node is included in the subject line of the AutoSupport message. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: is_minimal
options.description: Specifies whether the system information is collected in compliant form, to remove private data or in complete form, to enhance diagnostics. Supported only with REST.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: local_collection_enabled
options.description: Specify whether collection of AutoSupport data when the AutoSupport daemon is disabled. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: mail_hosts
options.description: List of mail server(s) used to deliver AutoSupport messages via SMTP. Both host names and IP addresses may be used as valid input.

options.name: max_http_size
options.description: Specify delivery size limit for the HTTP transport protocol (in bytes). Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: max_smtp_size
options.description: Specify delivery size limit for the SMTP transport protocol (in bytes). Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: nht_data_enabled
options.description: Specify whether the disk health data is collected as part of the AutoSupport data. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: node_name
options.description: The name of the filer that owns the AutoSupport Configuration. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: noteto
options.description: Specifies up to five recipients of short AutoSupport e-mail messages. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: ondemand_enabled
options.description: Specify whether the AutoSupport OnDemand Download feature is enabled.

options.name: ontapi
options.description: The ontap api version to use

options.name: partner_addresses
options.description: Specifies up to five partner vendor recipients of full AutoSupport e-mail messages.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: perf_data_enabled
options.description: Specify whether the performance data is collected as part of the AutoSupport data. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: post_url
options.description: The URL used to deliver AutoSupport messages via HTTP POST. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: private_data_removed
options.description: Specify the removal of customer-supplied data. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: proxy_url
options.description: specify an HTTP or HTTPS proxy if the 'transport' parameter is set to HTTP or HTTPS and your organization uses a proxy. If authentication is required, use the format "username:password@host:port".

options.name: reminder_enabled
options.description: Specify whether AutoSupport reminders are enabled or disabled. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: retry_count
options.description: Specify the maximum number of delivery attempts for an AutoSupport message. Supported only with ZAPI.

options.name: smtp_encryption
options.description: The encryption protocol used to deliver AutoSupport messages via SMTP to the configured mail_hosts. Supported only with REST.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies whether the AutoSupport daemon is to be enabled or disabled. When this setting is absent, delivery of all AutoSupport messages is turned off.

options.name: support
options.description: Specifies whether AutoSupport notification to technical support is enabled.

options.name: to_addresses
options.description: Specifies up to five recipients of full AutoSupport e-mail messages.

options.name: transport
options.description: The name of the transport protocol used to deliver AutoSupport messages.

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: Whether to use REST or ZAPI. always -- will always use the REST API if the module supports REST. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST. An error is issued if a module option is not supported in REST. never -- will always use ZAPI if the module supports ZAPI.  An error may be issued if a REST option is not supported in ZAPI. auto -- will try to use the REST API if the module supports REST and modules options are supported.  Reverts to ZAPI otherwise.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: validate_digital_certificate
options.description: When set to true each node will validate the digital certificates that it receives. Supported only with ZAPI.
